text.Mech World:
How to Play Edit ==
When you play the Mech World you put a Outpost in play with a defense value of 6. The Mech World counts as an ally for all factions.
 Strategy Edit ==
In my reckoning the best Outpost you can buy for 5 trade. Bringing 6 defense into play and the possibility to trigger ally abilities of all the factions in play is huge. You cannot let this Outpost fall in the hands of your enemies!!
